title: Kim Kardashian cries 'what was this for' as All's Fair branded 'crime against television' - NewsBreak
text:
By Scarlett O'Toole ,
38 minutes ago Kim Kardashian has opened up about how she feels as her brand new show All's Fair has been ripped apart by critics.
The legal drama premiered on Disney+ on November 4, with the series being given a number of zero-star ratings . The program has even been called the "worst TV show of the year" and a "crime against television."
All's Fair got a 0% Rotten Tomatoes rating when it was released, though this has now risen to 5%. Kim spoke out about the backlash in the latest episode of The Kardashians , where she spoke to the cameras in her trailer after wrapping filming on All's Fair.

Kim admitted, "It's crazy that this journey is over," before opening up about her anxieties. She told the camera, "Here's the thing, these shows, it is not guaranteed that it is gonna be a hit. So you put your heart and soul and your time into something and it’s like, what if it doesn’t hit? Then like, what was this for?"
Kim laughed as she continued, "I mean, obviously everything in life, you gotta take risks to get there, but I've taken all the risks. I’ve done all the… I’ve made it."
Speaking in a confessional, she opened up about the differences between acting and appearing on a reality TV show. "I think doing a scripted show is more pressure," the 45-year-old shared.
Kim added, "There’s definitely a judging meter on like, you can act or you are a bad actress. And being on a reality show, you’re just living your life the only way that you know how. There’s not a meter of like, we’re living our reality TV life well or not well."
